result.instructions: Tools for Spoke Dispatch, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What delivery plans do I have for tomorrow?"; "Which drivers do we have on the team and are they active?"; "How many stops are on today's delivery routes for each driver?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Spoke Dispatch data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run spoke_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run spoke_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run spoke_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. spoke_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: spoke_list_plans
tools.title: List plans
tools.description: List route plans (a plan = one day's delivery job: date, depot, drivers, routes), newest first, in pages of up to 20. Filter with e.g. {"title":"Monday run"} or {"startsGte":"2026-10-01"}. GET /plans.

starts_on_or_after.description: Only plans starting on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

filter.description: Extra filter fields as documented by Spoke (name -> value), e.g. {"startsGte":"2026-10-01"}.

page_token.description: Page token: pass the previous reply's nextPageToken (with the same other arguments) for the next page.

tools.name: spoke_get_plan
tools.title: Get plan
tools.description: One plan: title, start date, depot, driver ids, route ids, whether it is distributed/writable, optimization state and route overrides. GET /plans/{planId}.

tools.name: spoke_list_plan_stops
tools.title: List plan stops
tools.description: List the stops of a plan, in pages of up to 10. Stops include recipient names, phones, e-mails and addresses (personal data): page only as far as needed. GET /plans/{planId}/stops.

recipient_external_id.description: Only stops whose recipient has this external id.

page_token.description: Page token: pass the previous reply's nextPageToken (with the same other arguments) for the next page.

tools.name: spoke_get_stop
tools.title: Get stop
tools.description: One stop of a plan with address, recipient, timing, ETA, route and delivery outcome (attempted, succeeded, notes, photo/signature links). Contains personal data. GET /plans/{planId}/stops/{stopId}.

tools.name: spoke_search_stops
tools.title: Search stops
tools.description: Search all stops of the team (planned, unassigned, past) by keyword and/or Spoke's filter language, up to 20 per page. Example filter: address.countryCode = "DE" and deliveryInfo.attempted = false. Filterable: planId, routeId, type, activity, notes, address.*, createdAt, recipient.name/email/phone/externalId, deliveryInfo.state/attempted/succeeded, orderInfo.*. Results include personal data. The search index lags real time by a short while. GET /stops:search.

filter.description: Spoke filter expression, e.g. createdAt >= "2026-10-01T00:00:00Z" and address ~= "London".

page_token.description: Page token: pass the previous reply's nextPageToken (with the same other arguments) for the next page.

tools.name: spoke_list_unassigned_stops
tools.title: List unassigned stops
tools.description: List stops that are not on any plan yet (the inbox of imported orders), in pages of up to 20 (default 20). Contains personal data. GET /unassignedStops.

page_token.description: Page token: pass the previous reply's nextPageToken (with the same other arguments) for the next page.

tools.name: spoke_get_unassigned_stop
tools.title: Get unassigned stop
tools.description: One unassigned stop by id. Contains personal data. GET /unassignedStops/{id}.

tools.name: spoke_list_drivers
tools.title: List drivers
tools.description: List the team's drivers (name, e-mail/phone, active flag, depots, route overrides), up to 50 per page. Contains personal data. GET /drivers.

page_token.description: Page token: pass the previous reply's nextPageToken (with the same other arguments) for the next page.

tools.name: spoke_get_driver
tools.title: Get driver
tools.description: One driver by id. Contains personal data. GET /drivers/{driverId}.

tools.name: spoke_list_depots
tools.title: List depots
tools.description: List depots (start/end addresses, working hours, vehicle type, max stops), up to 20 per page. Use the ids when creating plans. GET /depots.

page_token.description: Page token: pass the previous reply's nextPageToken (with the same other arguments) for the next page.

tools.name: spoke_get_depot
tools.title: Get depot
tools.description: One depot by id. GET /depots/{depotId}.

tools.name: spoke_list_routes
tools.title: List routes
tools.description: List routes (one driver's run of a plan: stop count, driver, distributed/started/completed state), up to 20 per page. GET /routes.

starts_on_or_after.description: Only routes of plans starting on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

page_token.description: Page token: pass the previous reply's nextPageToken (with the same other arguments) for the next page.

tools.name: spoke_get_route
tools.title: Get route
tools.description: One route: title, driver, stop count and state (distributed, started, completed, recipients notified). GET /routes/{routeId}.

tools.name: spoke_list_route_stops
tools.title: List route stops
tools.description: List the stops of one route in driving order, in pages of up to 10. Contains personal data: page only as far as needed. GET /routes/{routeId}/stops.

recipient_external_id.description: Only stops whose recipient has this external id.

page_token.description: Page token: pass the previous reply's nextPageToken (with the same other arguments) for the next page.

tools.name: spoke_list_operations
tools.title: List operations
tools.description: List long-running operations (plan optimizations): type, done flag, who started it, result (optimized and skipped stops), up to 20 per page. GET /operations.

page_token.description: Page token: pass the previous reply's nextPageToken (with the same other arguments) for the next page.

tools.name: spoke_get_operation
tools.title: Get operation
tools.description: One operation, e.g. the optimization started by spoke_optimize_plan: poll until done is true. GET /operations/{operationId}.

tools.name: spoke_list_custom_stop_properties
tools.title: List custom stop properties
tools.description: The team's custom stop property definitions (ids and names). Their ids are the keys of customProperties on stops. Needs a subscription that includes custom properties (HTTP 403 otherwise). GET /team/customStopProperties.

tools.name: spoke_create_plan
tools.title: Create plan
tools.description: WRITE: create a new route plan for a date (no stops yet, nothing is sent to drivers). Optionally assign drivers (up to 50, they must be active and share the plan's depot) and a depot (default: the team's main depot). Does not optimize or distribute. POST /plans.

starts_on.description: Plan date, yyyy-mm-dd (Spoke rejects dates too far in the past or future).

tools.name: spoke_update_plan
tools.title: Update plan
tools.description: WRITE: change a plan's title, date, drivers and/or depot. Only the fields you pass change, but driver_ids REPLACES the plan's whole driver list. Fails if the plan is not writable (already distributed). Nothing is sent to drivers. PATCH /plans/{planId}.

driver_ids.description: The complete new driver list (replaces the old one).

tools.name: spoke_create_stop
tools.title: Create stop
tools.description: WRITE: add one stop to a writable (not yet distributed) plan. Needs an address (text fields or latitude+longitude). The recipient's phone/e-mail are stored on the stop and Spoke may contact the recipient later when the route runs; nothing is sent now. For many stops use spoke_import_stops. POST /plans/{planId}/stops.

address_name.description: Display name only (not used for geocoding), e.g. 'Rear entrance'.

latitude.description: Overrides the text fields; give both latitude and longitude or neither.

address.description: Stop address. Give at least one field; the more fields, the better the geocoding.

recipient_phone.description: Recipient phone (E.164 preferred). Stored on the stop; Spoke may text it when the route runs.

recipient_email.description: Recipient e-mail. Stored on the stop; Spoke may e-mail tracking updates when the route runs.

optimization_order.description: Force the stop first or last in the optimized route.

earliest_attempt_time.description: Time window start, HH:MM (local time of the stop).

estimated_attempt_duration_seconds.description: Expected time at the stop, in seconds.

allowed_driver_ids.description: Only these drivers (ids or 'drivers/<id>'; they must be on the plan) may serve the stop.

tools.name: spoke_import_stops
tools.title: Import stops
tools.description: WRITE: add up to 100 stops to a writable (not yet distributed) plan in one request (better geocoding than one at a time; Spoke limits imports to 30 requests a minute). Returns the created stop ids and any failures. Recipient contact data is stored on the stops; nothing is sent now. POST /plans/{planId}/stops:import.

address_name.description: Display name only (not used for geocoding), e.g. 'Rear entrance'.

latitude.description: Overrides the text fields; give both latitude and longitude or neither.

address.description: Stop address. Give at least one field; the more fields, the better the geocoding.

recipient_phone.description: Recipient phone (E.164 preferred). Stored on the stop; Spoke may text it when the route runs.

recipient_email.description: Recipient e-mail. Stored on the stop; Spoke may e-mail tracking updates when the route runs.

optimization_order.description: Force the stop first or last in the optimized route.

earliest_attempt_time.description: Time window start, HH:MM (local time of the stop).

estimated_attempt_duration_seconds.description: Expected time at the stop, in seconds.

allowed_driver_ids.description: Only these drivers (ids or 'drivers/<id>'; they must be on the plan) may serve the stop.

tools.name: spoke_optimize_plan
tools.title: Optimize plan
tools.description: WRITE: start the route optimization of a plan (orders and assigns its stops to its drivers). Rewrites the plan's routes if it was optimized before, and uses Spoke's optimization quota (30 per minute, 100 per 10 minutes). Does NOT send anything to drivers. Returns an operation: poll spoke_get_operation until done. Needs at least one driver and one stop. POST /plans/{planId}:optimize.

tools.name: spoke_distribute_plan
tools.title: Distribute plan to drivers
tools.description: WRITE (SENDS TO REAL PEOPLE): distribute an optimized plan, which immediately sends each driver of the plan their route on their phone (push notification / message) and locks the plan for edits. Cannot be undone. Only for a plan with 1-10 drivers, and only after the user has explicitly said to send the routes: set confirm_send_to_drivers to true. POST /plans/{planId}:distribute.

confirm_send_to_drivers.description: Must be true: confirms the user asked to send the routes to the plan's drivers now.
